references.text: The prophet Isaiah predicts that the Messiah will open the eyes of the blind and the ears of the deaf, which mirrors the miracles Jesus performed.
The book of Psalms describes God's ability to give speech to the mute and hearing to the deaf, which is reflected in Jesus' actions.
Jesus refers to Isaiah's prophecies about giving sight to the blind and hearing to the deaf as proof that He is the promised Messiah.
A parallel event where Jesus heals many, including the deaf and mute, and people marvel at His miracles.
